aiResearchSummary.text: Kenota Health is engaged in research and development of a sample collection apparatus for fluid handling of small amounts of sample fluid and loading of a syringe, as described in the title 'Sample collection apparatus.' The abstract details its use as a precise dispense device within instruments such as analytical or point-of-care devices, aligning with the company's focus on next-generation diagnostic tools for allergy testing. Their work centers on improving sample collection and fluid handling in diagnostic applications.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $9,000,000, or 81.42% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $53,491, representing 0.48% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,310,646 to $35,678,541, a 4.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
